response.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB * 1.0 / NULLIF(HCT, 0)) AS r, AVG(PIC) AS pic FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID HAVING AVG(HGB * 1.0 / NULLIF(HCT, 0)) IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS m FROM p) SELECT AVG(p.pic) AS mean_avg_pic, AVG(p.r) AS mean_ratio, AVG(p.r - a.m) AS mean_excess FROM p, a WHERE p.r > a.m
